parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: The industry. After you specify this parameter, only content from websites within the specified industries is recalled. Separate multiple industries with commas.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query text to search for.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: The session ID for multi-turn interactions.

parameters.name: timeRange
parameters.description: The time range for filtering web pages by publish time.
